purpose: Record that yeslab_436 (GP_067), yeslab_446 (GP_077) and yeslab_468 (GP_099) are structurally degenerate: their final operation is turnover multiplied by a per-date cross-sectional scalar, so their cross-sectional rank equals +/- the rank of turnover_rate on every day. They carry no stock-specific information and are perfectly redundant with each other.
label: forward_open_5d:v1

empirical_evidence.observation: Daily RankIC series of yeslab_436, yeslab_446 and yeslab_468 are exactly identical over all 36 signal days; yeslab_464 differs.

decision: REJECT_STRUCTURAL_DEGENERACY_FOR_FAMILY_436_446_468_426; other family members already rejected by predictive gates. Full training-window evaluation of 436/446/468 proceeds only to document the degeneracy empirically; their admission is excluded regardless of gate outcomes.
decision_reason: A factor equal to turnover_rate times a per-date scalar has the same cross-sectional ranks as turnover_rate (or its reversal) every day. The three factors are mutually redundant (median abs Spearman = 1.0 by construction, above the 0.90 threshold) and add no information beyond a signed turnover stream. They must not be admitted regardless of gate outcomes in the full training window.
yeslab_464_note: GP_Factor_095 ends in a per-stock regression residual; its smoke-window RankIC series differs from the turnover-scalar triple.
formal_nine_check: The final operations of GP_036/GP_012/GP_056/GP_074 (yeslab_405/381/425/443) and GP_095 are stock-specific; no degenerate turnover-scalar structure found in the formal nine or READY candidates.

full_degenerate_family.definition: Final factor equals a raw market field (turnover_rate or amount) multiplied by a per-date cross-sectional scalar. Cross-sectional ranks equal +/- the ranks of that field on every day; such factors carry no stock-specific information.
full_degenerate_family.note: The amount family members with identical 2020 ICIR (-0.222) are themselves mutually rank-identical, consistent with the shared degenerate structure.
